Pitavastatin Is Well-Tolerated With no Detrimental Effects on Physical Function. Little is known about the potential benefits or harms of statins on physical function among people with human immunodeficiency virus (PWH). REPRIEVE was a double-blind randomized controlled trial evaluating pitavastatin for primary prevention of major adverse cardiovascular events in PWH.
